shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md && if [ -f AGENTS.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md; fi && rg --files -g 'SKILL.md' -g '.lore/test-commands.yml'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,240p' package.json && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,240p' src/types/ai.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md 2>/dev/null || true && sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n 'ToolRegistry|inputSchema|validated by' src/orchestration -g '*.test.ts' specs | head -120"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.+#[0-9]+|@spec|spec:' src -g '*.test.ts' | head -80 && sed -n '1,150p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,100p' jest.config.js && git log -5 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'require-spec-link|spec anchor|specs/.+#' eslint.config.mjs scripts src -g '*.ts' -g '*.mjs' | head -100 && rg -n 'validated by:' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts package.json .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "feat(tools): compile static input schemas" -m "Relates to #37" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD'"
